meta.title: Plans: Foundation, Growth and CFO Finance Subscriptions
meta.description: Compare Yaqeen Advisory plans for India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia: Foundation, Growth and CFO. See what is included, add-on modules and how pricing works.

hero.heading: Pick the depth of insight you need.
hero.text: The same accounting and compliance engine runs underneath every tier. What changes is how much analysis and advice sits on top. Pay for what you use, never for what you do not.

layers.heading: Three layers. Pay only for what you use.
layers.text: Every client gets a core subscription. Add modules when you need them, and bring in projects for one-time work. Packs never force you to buy things you do not need.

items.title: Core subscription
items.text: Choose a tier: Foundation, Growth or CFO. The tier sets the depth of insight, from compliance to analysis to strategy.

items.title: Add-on modules
items.text: Switch on extra capacity or capability when you need it: more employees, more entities, Ind AS or IFRS reporting and more.
items.pricing: Priced by the driver: per head, per entity or per cycle

items.title: Projects
items.text: Books clean-ups, audit readiness, financial models, system setup and automation. Scoped up front, delivered with a clear handover.

layers.note: A client who outgrows a limit pays for the extra volume. They do not jump to a bigger tier. Tiers change only when you want a different kind of value: more analysis, forecasting or strategy.

priceDrivers.title: Transaction volume
priceDrivers.text: Entries per month fall into bands: up to 150, 151 to 400, 401 to 800, and above 800 on a custom quote.

priceDrivers.title: Headcount
priceDrivers.text: Each plan includes payroll up to a limit. Extra employees are charged per head, so you never have to change plans just for payroll.

priceDrivers.title: Entities
priceDrivers.text: Each additional company, LLP, proprietorship or branch with separate books is added as a module.

priceDrivers.title: Registrations
priceDrivers.text: Extra GST or VAT registrations add filings, so they are priced per registration.

tiersText: Start where you are. Move up when you want more analysis, forecasting or strategy.

tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.bestFor: Owner-led businesses that need clean books, on-time filings and a clear monthly picture.
features: Full bookkeeping with month-end close by the 7th
Tax filings as applicable: GST, TDS and income tax in India; VAT, corporate tax or Zakat in the Gulf
tiers.outcome: No compliance surprises, and you always know your numbers.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.bestFor: Growing businesses with a team, several cost centres, or lenders and investors asking questions.
features: Custom KPIs, department and project views
Budget vs actual and a 13-week cash forecast
Audit readiness and a quarterly review call
tiers.outcome: You see what drives profit and cash, and you act on it.

tiers.name: CFO
tiers.bestFor: Businesses planning a raise, an expansion or a bank facility that want finance leadership without a full-time CFO.
features: FP&A: budgets, rolling forecasts and scenarios
Monthly review call and up to 12 hours of modelling support a year
tiers.outcome: A finance partner in the room when decisions get made.

addonsHeading: Add capacity or capability when you need it
addonsText: Recurring modules that sit on top of your core subscription. Each is priced by the thing that drives the work.

addons.name: Extra payroll headcount
addons.text: Payroll processing, payslips and statutory filings for employees above your plan limit.

addons.name: Additional entity
addons.text: Full plan scope for another company, LLP or proprietorship, with consolidated MIS when the entities are related.

addons.name: Additional GST or VAT registration
addons.text: Returns, reconciliation and credit tracking for each extra registration.

addons.name: Interim financial statements
addons.text: Quarterly or half-yearly statements for lenders, investors or group reporting.

addons.name: Ind AS reporting
addons.text: Ind AS statements with disclosures for companies that must or choose to follow Ind AS.

addons.name: IFRS reporting
addons.text: IFRS or IFRS for SMEs statements with disclosures, including group reporting needs.

addons.name: Consolidation
addons.text: Group consolidation with intercompany eliminations and currency translation.

addons.name: Transfer pricing support (UAE and KSA)
addons.text: Related-party mapping, benchmarking inputs and disclosure preparation.

addons.name: Additional MIS packs
addons.text: Department, branch, product or project-level reporting on top of your standard MIS.

addons.name: Extra advisory hours
addons.text: Time on pricing, expansion, funding or restructuring decisions beyond your plan.

faqs.q: Why are monthly fees not listed?
faqs.a: Fees depend on your monthly transaction volume, headcount, number of entities and registrations. After a 30-minute discovery call we send a scoped proposal within 2 working days, with your plan, add-ons and fee in plain language.

faqs.q: What happens if my business grows past a plan limit?
faqs.a: You pay for the extra volume or headcount, for example extra employees per head. You do not have to jump to a bigger tier. Tiers change only when you want a different kind of value, such as forecasting or strategy.

Filings are scoped at onboarding to what applies to your registrations. If you have no GST or TDS obligation, you are not billed for them. Government fees, interest and penalties are paid by you at actuals.
Yes. Many clients start with Foundation or a books clean-up project and move to Growth or CFO as they need more analysis or planning.

faqs.q: Do you also do one-time work?
faqs.a: Yes. Projects such as books clean-up, IFRS or Ind AS conversion, financial model builds, due diligence support and system setup are scoped up front for a fixed fee.

cta.heading: Not sure which plan fits?
cta.text: Tell us about your business. We will recommend a plan and send a scoped proposal within 2 working days.
